Example Mixed-Use Building at 100 Example Street

Location: 100 Example Street and 102, 104 Example Street
File Number: LU009999
Applicant: Example Architecture Ltd.

The City of Delta has received a revised application for the properties at 100 Example Street and 102, 104 Example Street. The purpose of the revised application is to permit a six-storey mixed-use building with ground floor commercial units and 67 residential apartment units. The original application was submitted January 5, 2024. The applicant has since revised the application with key changes, as follows: increase storey height from five to six storeys, roof building height from 17.3 m to 23 m, increase number of residential units from 65 units to 67 units and eliminate 13 lock-off suites, increase the floor space ratio from 0.98 to 1.36.

Additional information on the original and revised applications are provided below.

Revised Application Overview: This application is for a mixed-use building with ground-floor commercial units and 67 residential apartment units. The following are key aspects of the revised proposal.

  • 772 m² of commercial floor area at-grade and 10,842 m² of residential floor area at-grade and above
  • 67 residential market apartment units, including a mix of 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom units
  • 6 storeys and maximum building height of 23 m plus 2 levels of underground parking
  • 115 vehicle parking spaces including 73 resident spaces and 35 commercial spaces
  • 90 bicycle parking spaces including 6 commercial and 84 residential

Original Application Overview: This original application was for a mixed-use building with 65 residential apartment units.

  • 6,467 m² of residential floor area
  • 65 residential apartment units including 13 lock-off units
  • 5 storeys and maximum building height of 17.3 m
  • 143 vehicle parking spaces
